== Summary ==
Identified: [[Kevin Shannon]] (left) and [[Brian Herold]] (right). Remaining faces unlabeled.
The final of the [[2011 World Championship]] (Washington, D.C., 14 August 2011), in which [[Kevin Shannon]] defeated [[Brian Herold]]. Posted by kcaton under "Finals:"; the post does not mark which player is which.

== Source ==
Posted on the Players Committee forum by kcaton: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=641721#p641721 post 641721], "Pics from worlds" (topic 42419), 16 August 2011 ("These were pretty much all posted on Twitter ... the full pics are on photobucket as well"). Photobucket album kcpokka. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261122230953/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p641721.html Internet Archive]
* '''Watermark:''' This copy carries the Groupsy/Photobucket watermark that Photobucket stamped on re-served images; no unwatermarked copy was found (the Photobucket album is no longer public).
